sources.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
sources.snippet: From our March 2025 arXiv paper on sequence conversion trajectories to Laya: a sub-35ms open-weight System 1 decision engine with RLCD, multilingual routing across 100+ languages, and state-of-the-art calibration.
